definition: EveryNextAllowed requires a witness trace for each Boolean next outcome in a supplied admissibility class. A class containing only everywhere-true traces fails it despite NoDemonstration False. Admissibility is a stipulated interpretation parameter, not metaphysical accessibility; it refutes the bare logical inference to unrestricted outcomes, not a modal theory.
note: Bounded analytical vocabulary for #269. This definition fixes test semantics; source endorsement or normative adequacy is not established by naming it.
